entries.title: Soft launch
body: HozWorld is live at app.hozworld.com and on itch.io. GG!
This is still an alpha: things may change, break or be reset.
Thanks for playing and sharing feedback.

entries.title: Oct 26, 2026
body: New start screen, loading art and music
Village music; only the 3 huts remain, with new trees and rocks
Trees, rocks and huts are now solid
Riverlands, Frontier and Ashlands monsters are 30% stronger
